prompt: You recently ordered a table online, but when it arrived it was damaged. Write a letter to the customer service manager of the company. In your letter:
bullets: describe what you ordered and when it arrived
explain what is wrong with it
say what you would like the company to do
modelAnswer:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a dining table that I ordered from your website on 3 March. The order number is 48215.

The table was delivered on 12 March, which was two days later than promised. When I unpacked it, I discovered a deep scratch across the top and one of the legs was cracked, so the table is not safe to use. The delivery driver did not wait while I checked it, and the packaging was torn, which suggests that the damage happened during transport.

I paid £320 for the table, and I am extremely disappointed with both the quality and the service. I would therefore be grateful if you could arrange for a replacement to be delivered as soon as possible. If a new table is not available, I would like a full refund, together with someone to collect the damaged one at no cost to me. I have attached photographs showing the damage.

I look forward to hearing from you within the next seven days. If I do not receive a satisfactory reply, I will have to contact a consumer advice organisation.

Yours faithfully,
David Hughes
examinerComment: All three bullets are covered with relevant detail. The tone is consistently formal, with a suitable opening and closing and logical paragraphing.
usefulPhrases: I am writing to complain about ...
I would be grateful if you could ...
I look forward to hearing from you.
